newsitem.title: UK: StanChart sets Asia link with First Chicago.
newsitem.headline: StanChart sets Asia link with First Chicago.

text.p: Standard Chartered Bank, a unit of Standard Chartered Plc, said it has agreed to provide cash management services for the clients of First Chicago NBD Corp in South East Asia and Hong Kong.
Under the agreement, First Chicago will provide clients with an integrated package incorporating Standard Chartered's cash management products.

First Chicago said it will streamline access by integrating account opening, implementation and customer service, adding capability in Thailand, Malaysia and Indonesia and expanding services provided in Hong Kong and Singapore.
